advisory_board.name: Alexandra C. Newton, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Molecular mechanisms of signal transduction, focusing on protein kinases and phosphatases, particularly protein kinase C (PKC), and their roles in cell signaling and disease.

advisory_board.name: Jin Zhang, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Spatiotemporal regulation of cell signaling pathways using genetically encoded fluorescent biosensors and advanced imaging.

advisory_board.name: Alan R. Saltiel, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Insulin signaling and regulation of cellular sugar levels, with implications for obesity, diabetes, and other metabolic disorders.

advisory_board.name: Peter Yingxiao Wang, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Genetically encoded FRET biosensors for visualizing and quantifying molecular signals in live cells under physical and mechanical environments.

advisory_board.name: Hui-wang Ai, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Molecular probes, including bioluminescent sensors, for cellular communications involving redox-active molecules, neurotransmitters, and protein post-translational modifications.

advisory_board.name: Jennifer A. Prescher, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Custom tools to visualize cellular networks in real time, with relevance to infectious disease, cancer metastasis, and immune function.

advisory_board.name: Eric D. Petersen, Ph.D.
advisory_board.institution: Central Michigan University College of Medicine
advisory_board.expertise: Genetically encoded tools using rational protein design and protein evolution to report or control cell signaling and neuronal activity.

advisory_board.name: Robert E. Campbell, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Engineering of fluorescent proteins and genetically encoded biosensors to study neuronal activity and biochemistry.

advisory_board.name: Ben Campbell, Ph.D.
advisory_board.expertise: Biosensors for real-time, multicolor, and multi-organelle redox imaging in human cells and other organisms.

advisory_board.name: Loren L. Looger, Ph.D.
advisory_board.institution: University of California, San Diego; Howard Hughes Medical Institute
advisory_board.expertise: Protein engineering of intensity-based fluorescent biosensors from GFP and periplasmic binding proteins for small-molecule studies in neurobiology.

advisory_board.name: Oliver Griesbeck, Ph.D.
advisory_board.institution: Max Planck Institute for Biological Intelligence
advisory_board.expertise: Protein biosensors for neuronal activity and biochemistry, integrating biophysical and structural studies with molecular biology.

advisory_board.name: Eric R. Schreiter, Ph.D.
advisory_board.institution: Janelia Research Campus, Howard Hughes Medical Institute
advisory_board.expertise: Molecular tools to visualize and dissect neuronal circuits, including protein-based tools for neurobiology.

advisory_board.name: Ryohei Yasuda, Ph.D.
advisory_board.institution: Max Planck Florida Institute for Neuroscience
advisory_board.expertise: Mechanisms of synaptic signaling and plasticity, using advanced imaging to study signaling networks underlying learning and memory.
